punchline: Ray Kroc reportedly told a room of MBA students that McDonald's wasn't really in the hamburger business.
thirty_sec: Ray Kroc, the McDonald's founder, was having drinks with some MBA students and asked them what business he was in. They laughed and said hamburgers. He said no, real estate. The franchises were a way to get the best corners, and McDonald's ended up one of the biggest property owners in the world. Robert Kiyosaki uses the story to say your job is your profession, and what you own is your business.
question: Which company do you know that makes its real money from something other than what it's famous for?
